pros.title: very available and cheap
pros.explanation: That is about the only practical argument it has.

pros.title: use case can matter more than macros
pros.explanation: If someone wants a sweet drink, the job is pleasure and context, not nutrition.

pros.title: sometimes makes sense in a narrow use case
pros.explanation: A small planned serving is different from making it the default drink.

cons.title: sweet format can stack up fast
cons.explanation: Small-looking portions can still push the day away from the cleaner use case.

cons.title: basically no useful nutrition
cons.explanation: It gives up nutritional value while still costing calories.

cons.title: easy to oversell beyond what the numbers support
cons.explanation: Regular cola works as a treat, but the nutrition case is very thin.

scoreReadiness.summary: Representative finalisation sample with per-100g basis, structured source references, and current scoring/display guardrails applied.
caveats: Real foods vary by cultivar, brand, season, and preparation; this record is a canonical comparison entry rather than a guarantee for every product.

sourceNotes: All displayed nutrition values are stored and checked on a per-100g basis.
